title: BM25 lexical ranking
text: BM25 is a lexical information retrieval ranking function. It scores documents by query term frequency, inverse document frequency, and document length normalization.

title: TF-IDF basics
text: TF-IDF ranks documents using term frequency and inverse document frequency. It is simpler than BM25 and does not use term frequency saturation.

title: HNSW approximate nearest neighbor
text: HNSW builds a multi-layer graph for approximate nearest neighbor search. It often provides high recall and low latency for vector databases.

title: IVF vector index
text: IVF partitions vector space into clusters. Search probes a subset of clusters to reduce latency and memory pressure, sometimes at the cost of recall.

title: RAG pipeline
text: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves relevant chunks from a search system and provides them as context to a large language model for answer generation.

title: Cross encoder reranking
text: A reranker reads the query and candidate document together and produces a relevance score. Reranking improves the ordering of results retrieved by BM25 or vector search.

title: BGE reranker
text: BGE reranker models such as bge-reranker-base and bge-reranker-v2-m3 are cross-encoder models that score query and passage pairs for relevance.

title: OpenSearch hybrid search
text: OpenSearch supports keyword search with BM25 and vector search with k-NN indexes. Hybrid search combines lexical and semantic retrieval signals.

title: Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases
text: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases can connect foundation models to enterprise data sources by retrieving relevant chunks from a vector store.

title: Fixed income portfolio analytics
text: Fixed income portfolio analytics often require searching issuer, sector, duration, spread, yield, benchmark, and risk attribution documents.

title: Heart attack symptoms
text: Myocardial infarction, commonly called a heart attack, can include chest pain, shortness of breath, nausea, sweating, and pain radiating to the arm or jaw.

title: Healthy heart diet
text: A heart healthy diet includes vegetables, fruits, whole grains, lean proteins, and reduced saturated fat. It is different from emergency heart attack symptoms.
